name: campus-ai-os
description: Campus AI OS - the complete starter campus. The kernel (chief of staff Dean, founding onboarding, campus doctor, dashboard, wiki memory, self-authoring skill loop) plus 4 scaffolded department managers and a full starter staff of AI employees (morning brief, weekly review, offer and course builders, email sequences, social planner, and more). Also a playbooks runtime that runs multi-step workflows end to end, built-in workforce governance, and optional per-stage model routing.

interface.shortDescription: Staff your education business with an AI team that remembers.
interface.longDescription: Campus AI OS turns a folder into a working campus: a chief of staff who knows your business, shared memory that compounds, four department managers, a starter staff of AI employees, playbooks that run multi-step work end to end, and health checks that tell you when something is off. File-based and portable - markdown and JSON, no vendor calls in the kernel.
defaultPrompt: Turn one recording into a week of content.
